text:
ara: Quick sync after RFC: proposing 'compat sneak-preview' metric: percent of requests that would translate perfectly if shim active. Useful to prioritize client migrations. Thoughts?
dan: neat. need a cheap way to compute without full translation. Maybe use a lightweight heuristics matcher for field differences.
jen: or sample 1% and run full translation offline to validate heuristics.
ara: exact plan: sample 0.5% of traffic, run translator in dry-run mode (no routing change), compute perfect-match ratio, and tag tenant with migration_suitability_score. Helps PM prioritize outreach.
dan: privacy: dry-run logs may contain prompts. Ensure sampling respects privacy flags and PII masking.
jen: ops: ensure dry-run doesn't affect latency; run in background worker post-response.
ara: add metrics: compat.dryrun.sampled, compat.dryrun.match_rate, compat.suitability_score.
jen: rollout: internal -> opt-in tenants -> global opt-in. Provide a small dashboard in console.
dan: add pointer to SDK helper so clients can request dry-run results (maybe via a migration-assistant endpoint).
ara: will add that to RFC addendum. Target spike next week. ops-bot: dry-run worker queued (job: dryrun-4363334455-test).
